description: Source code for QAM256 demodulation with hardware acceleration support (AVX512, AVX2, NEON). Implements soft demodulation of 256-QAM symbols into log-likelihood ratios, including interval-based calculations and platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: demod_QAM256_avx512
methods.description: Platform-specific optimized function for demodulating 8 symbols into 64 LLRs using AVX512 instructions.

methods.name: demod_QAM256_avx2
methods.description: Platform-specific optimized function for demodulating 4 symbols into 32 LLRs using AVX2 instructions.

methods.name: demod_QAM256_neon
methods.description: Platform-specific optimized function for demodulating 4 symbols into 32 LLRs using NEON instructions.

methods.name: demod_256QAM_symbol_01
methods.description: Calculates LLR for bits 0 and 1 of a symbol given its value and reciprocal noise variance.

methods.name: demod_256QAM_symbol_23
methods.description: Calculates LLR for bits 2 and 3 of a symbol.

methods.name: demod_256QAM_symbol_45
methods.description: Calculates LLR for bits 4 and 5 of a symbol.

methods.name: demod_256QAM_symbol_67
methods.description: Calculates LLR for bits 6 and 7 of a symbol.

methods.name: ocudu::demodulate_soft_QAM256
methods.description: Main function to demodulate a span of symbols into LLRs, utilizing hardware acceleration if available, processing in batches for efficiency.
